kjv: in this place is [one] greater than the temple
mine: something greater than the temple is here
note: TR has masculine meizon ("one greater"); the earliest manuscripts have neuter meizon ("something greater"), as also in 12:41-42 where KJV supplies "a greater".

mine: in the belly of the great fish
